coordinate_unit_provenance: The original public scientific protocol declares angstrom; this format transport performs no unit conversion.
charge_scope: XYZ does not encode formal or total charge; null is preserved. Any same-state charge is supplied separately by the public study metadata and must not be inferred from coordinates.

provenance.operation: Source-text field transport only; no geometry embedding, optimization, reordering, centering, alignment, isotope/default-mass assignment or scientific answer computation.
provenance.atom_order: Exact original SDF atom-block / XYZ atom-line order. Every atom retained, including hydrogen.
provenance.source_geometry_role: Same immutable original supplied computational geometry; not an experimental measurement or newly generated conformer.
